http.notes: Basic tier: username/password and remote DNS through the shared engine; outside the Tier A/B release gates.

https.notes: Basic tier: HTTP CONNECT over TLS with username/password and remote DNS; outside the Tier A/B release gates.

socks5.notes: Basic tier: username/password and domain-name addressing; outside the Tier A/B release gates.

hysteria2.notes: Tier B: requires UDP egress and container UDP allowance; obfuscation support is declared per engine, never assumed.

wireguard.notes: Tier B: UDP-only outbound with a mandatory tunnel DNS; configs without tunnel DNS are rejected. Needs UDP egress and independent end-to-end verification.

limitations: TUIC is not supported in v1.
Shared engine is a single point of failure for all running profiles.
Management API is loopback-only and has no application-level authentication.
Basic-tier protocols are not part of the Tier A/B release gates; they must still fail closed and never silently downgrade to direct egress.
